interface.signature: print_nums(n1: int, n2: int, ..., nk: int) -> str

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and n > 0 for n in locals()['args'])
preconditions.description: All input arguments are positive integers.

postconditions.expression: len(locals()['args']) == len([line for line in return_value.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The output string contains exactly one line per input number.

postconditions.expression: all(str(n).lstrip('0') == str(n) for n in locals()['args'])
postconditions.description: No input number has leading zeros (redundant due to P1, but preserved for clarity).

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == max(len(str(n)) for n in locals()['args']) for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Every line in the output has the same width, equal to the length of the largest input number's string representation.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('0') == (str(n) != max(str(n) for n in locals()['args'])) for n, line in zip(locals()['args'], return_value.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The largest input number (by string length) has no leading zeros, while all others have leading zeros to match its width.

postconditions.expression: all(line == str(n).zfill(max(len(str(n)) for n in locals()['args'])) for n, line in zip(locals()['args'], return_value.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each line is the input number left-padded with zeros to match the width of the largest input number's string representation.
